statements.status_notes: This CVE affects the USB gadget FunctionFS (f_fs) driver (drivers/usb/gadget/function/f_fs.c). The MA35D1 defconfig enables the USB gadget core (CONFIG_USB_GADGET) but does not enable the FunctionFS gadget function driver (no CONFIG_USB_F_FS / CONFIG_USB_CONFIGFS_F_FS). The vulnerable code path is not compiled into the delivered product.
This CVE affects the MPLS subsystem (net/mpls/). The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable CONFIG_MPLS_ROUTING; the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.

This CVE affects the ASoC SoundWire Device Class Audio (SDCA) framework (sound/soc/sdca/), used by SoundWire-attached audio codecs on platforms such as Qualcomm/Intel laptops. The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable CONFIG_SND_SOC_SDCA and uses its own on-chip SoC audio path instead; the vulnerable code is not present in the delivered product.

This CVE affects the sched_ext (BPF-extensible scheduler class) subsystem (kernel/sched/ext.c), which requires CONFIG_SCHED_CLASS_EXT. This option is not enabled in the MA35D1 defconfig; the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.
This CVE affects the 802.1Q VLAN subsystem (net/8021q/). The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable CONFIG_VLAN_8021Q; the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.

This CVE affects the Greybus 'raw' protocol driver (drivers/staging/greybus/raw.c), part of the Greybus/UniPro subsystem used on Project Ara/Motorola Moto Mods hardware. The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable CONFIG_GREYBUS; the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.

statements.action_statement: The vulnerability affects the target product. Remediation should be performed by applying an equivalent backport or upgrading to a kernel release containing the official fix.
statements.status_notes: The MA35D1 BSP enables CONFIG_NET and CONFIG_INET. Its Linux 6.18.65 net/core/dev.c contains qdisc_pkt_len_init() without the header validation from the official fix. The affected core networking code is present; an equivalent backport or upgrade is required.

CVE.org Linux CNA identifies Linux 5.18 and later as affected, with the first listed fixed stable release at Linux 7.0.11. The vulnerability affects remote_i_size and zero_point synchronization in fs/netfs/. CONFIG_NETFS_SUPPORT is not selected by the MA35D1 defconfig because NFS_FSCACHE, AFS, Ceph, 9P, SMB/CIFS, and EROFS on-demand are disabled. Therefore the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.

CVE.org Linux CNA identifies Linux 6.12 and later as affected and lists Linux 7.2.7 as a fixed stable release. The vulnerability affects readahead synchronization in fs/netfs/. The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable any selector of CONFIG_NETFS_SUPPORT: NFS_FSCACHE, AFS, Ceph, 9P_FS, NET_9P, SMB/CIFS, and EROFS on-demand are disabled. CONFIG_NFS_FS alone does not select netfs, so the vulnerable code is not compiled into the delivered product.

CVE.org Linux CNA identifies Linux 6.16 and later as affected and lists Linux 7.2.7 as a fixed stable release. The vulnerability affects concurrent initialization of NVMe Flexible Data Placement information in the NVMe host core. The MA35D1 defconfig does not enable NVME_CORE, BLK_DEV_NVME, or any NVMe-over-Fabrics transport, and the platform has no PCI/PCIe controller. The vulnerable NVMe host component is not compiled into the delivered product.
The affected Intel TDX VM-exit handler is part of x86 KVM. MA35D1 uses ARM64, and neither x86 KVM nor Intel TDX host support is built.
The affected delegation handling belongs to the NFSv4 server. CONFIG_NFSD and CONFIG_NFSD_V4 are disabled. The enabled NFS client does not build the NFSv4 server.
The affected FIND response handling belongs to the in-kernel SMB/CIFS client. CONFIG_CIFS is disabled, so that client is not built.
The affected PFN cache belongs to KVM. CONFIG_KVM and CONFIG_HAVE_KVM_PFNCACHE are disabled, so the KVM PFN cache is not built.
The Linux CNA marks the upstream 6.18.65 version range affected. The modified code belongs to the s390 zcrypt driver, which the ARM64 MA35D1 build cannot include.
The affected reply validation belongs to the s390 zcrypt driver. The ARM64 MA35D1 build does not include s390 drivers.
The affected code belongs to the NVMe-over-TCP host driver. CONFIG_NVME_TCP and CONFIG_NVME_CORE are disabled. This decision rests on the TCP transport build gate, not on the absence of PCIe.
The affected code belongs to the ARM SMMUv3 driver and its Shared Virtual Addressing (SVA) support. Neither CONFIG_ARM_SMMU_V3 nor CONFIG_ARM_SMMU_V3_SVA is enabled.

CONFIG_KSM is enabled, but the affected KSM behavior requires userfaultfd write protection. CONFIG_USERFAULTFD is disabled and the userfaultfd write-protection helper returns false in that configuration, so the required feature is unavailable.
The affected tree-disconnect handling belongs to the kernel SMB server (ksmbd). CONFIG_SMB_SERVER is disabled, so ksmbd is not built.

CVE.org Linux CNA identifies the ACPI platform-device code as affected and lists Linux 7.2.6 as a fixed stable release for branches newer than the fixed 6.6/6.12 lines. The vulnerability affects drivers/acpi/acpi_platform.c. CONFIG_ACPI is not enabled in the MA35D1 ARM64 defconfig and is not default-enabled on ARM64, so the affected ACPI platform code is not compiled into the delivered product.

statements.action_statement: The vulnerability affects the target product. Remediation should be performed by applying an equivalent backport or upgrading to a kernel release containing the official fix.
statements.status_notes: The MA35D1 BSP enables CONFIG_EXT4_FS. Its Linux 6.18.65 fs/ext4/inode.c still uses the old transaction-credit calculation in ext4_do_writepages(). The Linux CNA lists no fixed 6.18 release, and the fix is not present in the assessed BSP source. An equivalent backport or upgrade is required.
